import { test } from '@e2e-dev/web';
import { expect } from 'e2e';

const first = () => { globalThis.initOrder = [...(globalThis.initOrder ?? []), 'first']; };
const second = () => {
  globalThis.initOrder = [...(globalThis.initOrder ?? []), 'second'];
  if (window.opener && location.href === 'about:blank') window.opener.postMessage({ kind: 'init-blank', order: [...globalThis.initOrder] }, '*');
};

/**
 * The first document of a shared-browser popup is best effort (#153): it may
 * miss an init script or run one more than once. This accepts any observation
 * whose entries are the configured scripts, and rejects a foreign value; the
 * guaranteed document is asserted separately.
 */
const bestEffortInitOrder = (value: unknown): boolean => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return true;
  return Array.isArray(value) && value.every(entry => entry === 'first' || entry === 'second');
};
const bestEffortFirstDocument = (snapshot: { first: unknown; final: unknown }): boolean =>
  bestEffortInitOrder(snapshot.first) && bestEffortInitOrder(snapshot.final);

test('existing document stays untouched until next navigation', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.goto('/main');
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  expect(await browser.evaluate(() => globalThis.initOrder ?? [])).toEqual([]);
  expect(await browser.evaluate(() => globalThis.firstInline)).toEqual([]);
  await browser.goto('/next');
  expect(await browser.evaluate(() => ({ first: globalThis.firstInline, final: globalThis.initOrder }))).toEqual({ first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
});

test('popup first inline sees each init once and reload starts a fresh document', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  await browser.goto('/main');
  const snapshots = await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let child;
    const snapshots = [];
    const dispose = () => { removeEventListener('message', received); removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose); };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-document') return;
      // Normalize absent init scripts so the documented first-document
      // limitation stays JSON-safe instead of failing the whole evaluation.
      snapshots.push({ first: event.data?.snapshot?.first ?? null, final: event.data?.snapshot?.final ?? null });
      if (snapshots.length === 1) { child.location.reload(); return; }
      dispose(); child.close(); resolve(snapshots);
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    child = window.open('/popup');
    if (!child) { dispose(); reject(new Error('Synthetic popup missing')); }
  }));
  // CONTRACT: a browser shared with another CDP client lets that client release
  // a popup's start pause before native registers init scripts. The popup's
  // first document is therefore best effort (it may miss the scripts or run one
  // twice); a document created after registration is guaranteed.
  expect(snapshots[1], 'CONTRACT (#153): the popup document this reload creates is started after registration, so it must see each init script exactly once, in order.').toEqual({ first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
  expect(Object.keys(snapshots[0]).toSorted()).toEqual(['final', 'first']);
  expect(bestEffortFirstDocument(snapshots[0]), 'CONTRACT (#153): a shared popup first document is best effort; #153 allows missing or duplicated init scripts, and this observation is not an init-coverage assertion.').toBe(true);
});

test('blank popup has each init once before explicit first navigation', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  await browser.goto('/main');
  // CONTRACT (#153): the blank popup's first document is best effort in a
  // shared browser. Its init script may post no ready signal at all, so the
  // wait below falls back to a bounded settle instead of hanging. Only the
  // signal proves registration preceded the blank document; the settle does
  // not, which is why the navigation below is reloaded without it.
  await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise<void>(resolve => {
    const child = window.open('about:blank');
    if (!child) throw new Error('Synthetic popup missing');
    globalThis.blankChild = child;
    globalThis.blankInitReady = false;
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (registered: boolean) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      globalThis.blankInitReady = registered;
      dispose();
      resolve();
    };
    const dispose = () => {
      removeEventListener('message', received);
      removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose);
      clearTimeout(fallback);
    };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-blank') return;
      finish(true);
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    const fallback = setTimeout(() => finish(false), 500);
  }));
  const snapshots = await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = globalThis.blankChild;
    if (!child) { reject(new Error('Synthetic popup missing')); return; }
    const registered = globalThis.blankInitReady === true;
    const blank = [...(child.initOrder ?? [])];
    let reloaded = false;
    const dispose = () => { removeEventListener('message', received); removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose); };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-document') return;
      // Normalize absent init scripts so the documented first-document
      // limitation stays JSON-safe instead of failing the whole evaluation.
      const next = { first: event.data?.snapshot?.first ?? null, final: event.data?.snapshot?.final ?? null };
      if (!registered && !reloaded) {
        // No registration evidence: this explicit navigation may have started
        // before registration. Reload into the document the contract
        // guarantees and assert that one instead.
        reloaded = true;
        child.location.reload();
        return;
      }
      dispose(); child.close(); delete globalThis.blankChild;
      resolve({ blank, reloaded, next });
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    child.location.href = '/popup';
  }));
  // CONTRACT (#153): with the blank document's init signal the explicit
  // navigation is the guaranteed document; without it the reload above is.
  expect(snapshots.next, 'CONTRACT (#153): the document created after registration (the explicit navigation when the blank document proved registration, otherwise its reload) must see each init script exactly once, in order.').toEqual({ first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
  expect(Array.isArray(snapshots.blank), 'CONTRACT (#153): a shared popup\'s blank first document is best effort; this records its observed init order without asserting coverage.').toBe(true);
  expect(bestEffortInitOrder(snapshots.blank), 'CONTRACT (#153): a shared popup\'s blank first document may miss or duplicate init scripts; its observation is not an init-coverage assertion.').toBe(true);
});

test('popup navigation it started itself keeps the guaranteed document boundary', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  await browser.goto('/main');
  const snapshots = await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let child;
    const snapshots = [];
    const dispose = () => { removeEventListener('message', received); removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose); };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-document') return;
      // Normalize absent init scripts so the documented first-document
      // limitation stays JSON-safe instead of failing the whole evaluation.
      snapshots.push({ path: event.data?.path ?? null, first: event.data?.snapshot?.first ?? null, final: event.data?.snapshot?.final ?? null });
      if (snapshots.length === 1) return; // The popup navigates itself to /next; the parent only listens.
      dispose(); child.close(); resolve(snapshots);
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    child = window.open('/self-nav');
    if (!child) { dispose(); reject(new Error('Synthetic popup missing')); }
  }));
  expect(snapshots.map(entry => entry.path)).toEqual(['/self-nav', '/next']);
  // CONTRACT: the popup's first document is best effort when the browser is
  // shared with another CDP client. The document its own navigation creates is
  // started after registration, so each init runs there exactly once, before
  // the document's own script.
  expect(snapshots[1], 'CONTRACT (#153): the document this popup navigation creates is started after registration, so it must see each init script exactly once, in order.').toEqual({ path: '/next', first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
  expect(Object.keys(snapshots[0]).toSorted()).toEqual(['final', 'first', 'path']);
  expect(bestEffortFirstDocument(snapshots[0]), 'CONTRACT (#153): a shared popup first document is best effort; #153 allows missing or duplicated init scripts, and this observation is not an init-coverage assertion.').toBe(true);
});
